task_description: Write a method in Dafny to count number items that are identical in the same position of three given lists.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method CountMatchingPositions(list1: seq<@>, list2: seq<@>, list3: seq<@>) returns (count: nat)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned count is equal to the number of positions where all three lists have identical items
- For each position i, if list1[i], list2[i], and list3[i] are all equal, then count is incremented by one
- The count accurately reflects the total number of such positions in the input lists
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method CountMatchingPositions(list1: seq<int>, list2: seq<int>, list3: seq<int>) returns (count: int)
    
Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - All input lists are not null
    - The method should handle lists of arbitrary length, including empty lists
    
Dafny specification:
    requires list1 != null
    requires list2 != null
    requires list3 != null
    
Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The count equals the number of positions i where list1[i], list2[i], and list3[i] are all equal
    
Dafny specification:
    ensures count == |{ i: int | 0 <= i < |list1| && list1[i] == list2[i] && list2[i] == list3[i] }|
    
Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
method CountMatchingPositions(list1: seq<int>, list2: seq<int>, list3: seq<int>) returns (count: int)
    requires list1 != null
    requires list2 != null
    requires list3 != null
{
    var minLength := if |list1| < |list2| then if |list1| < |list3| then |list1| else |list3| else if |list2| < |list3| then |list2| else |list3|;
    count := 0;
    var i := 0;
    while i < minLength
        invariant 0 <= i <= minLength
        invariant count == |{ j: int | 0 <= j < i && list1[j] == list2[j] && list2[j] == list3[j] }|
    {
        if list1[i] == list2[i] && list2[i] == list3[i] {
            count := count + 1;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
